lead.headline: DEEPSEEK-HARNESS SURGES TO #1 ON GITHUB
lead.deck: DeepSeek Harness surges to the forefront of GitHub's fastest-growing repositories, with a staggering 18,728 new stars in a single day
lead.body: The DeepSeek Harness project is revolutionizing the way developers approach software building by treating everything as a plugin. This innovative approach allows for unprecedented flexibility and customization, making it an attractive solution for a wide range of applications. By breaking down complex systems into modular components, DeepSeek Harness enables developers to easily swap out or add new features, streamlining the development process and reducing the time to market. As a result, the project has quickly gained a massive following among developers seeking to optimize their workflow and stay ahead of the competition
